description: This PHP class defines commands related to code coverage within the SuiteCRM testing environment, utilizing Robo task runner. It includes methods to run code coverage analysis, handle CI environments, and generate coverage reports.

classes.name: CodeCoverageCommands
classes.description: A Robo Tasks class that provides commands to execute code coverage analysis and reporting within the SuiteCRM project.

methods.name: codeCoverage
methods.description: Main method to run code coverage, optionally in a CI environment.

methods.name: isEnvironmentTravisCI
methods.description: Checks if the current environment is Travis CI.

methods.name: getCommitRangeForTravisCi
methods.description: Retrieves the commit range from Travis CI environment variables.

methods.name: generateCodeCoverageFile
methods.description: Executes the code coverage command to produce the report file.

methods.name: getCodeCoverageCommand
methods.description: Constructs the shell command to run PHPUnit with coverage options.
